issue.title: Agent-run Apollo pushes over forwarded SSH authenticate as the bobs-org/bob deploy key and are denied
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1nf.10.1.9.1.6.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1, "Restore apollo write access to agents remotes") and re-diagnosed by the sase-1nf.10.1.9.1.6 land agent on 2026-10-22. Apollo's write access was never lost. Every Apollo publication push that an agent runs over `ssh apollo ...` from Athena authenticates to GitHub as the read-only `bobs-org/bob` deploy key.

Root cause (traced live):

1. Athena's `~/.ssh/config` `Host *` block sets `ForwardAgent yes`, so `ssh apollo` forwards Athena's login agent. Athena's `ssh-add -l` lists `bob-vault-sync@athena` (the `bobs-org/bob` deploy key, `~/.ssh/id_bob_vault`) first.
2. Athena itself is protected by `Match originalhost github.com exec "test -r %d/.ssh/id_sase_service"` → `IdentitiesOnly yes`. Apollo has no `~/.ssh/id_sase_service`, so that match never applies there. Apollo's effective `github.com` config is `identitiesonly no`, and it offers the forwarded agent's keys first.
3. GitHub accepts the deploy key at auth time (`Hi bobs-org/bob!`), then refuses pushes with `ERROR: Permission to sase-org/sase--agents.git denied to deploy key`. Reads still work.

Reproduction on 2026-10-22 ~12:40Z, from Athena:

- `ssh apollo 'zsh -lc "ssh -T git@github.com"'` → `Hi bobs-org/bob!`. `git push --dry-run` from Apollo's `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents` → `denied to deploy key`.
- `ssh -o ForwardAgent=no apollo ...` → `Hi bbugyi200!`. The same dry-runs on both the sase and bob-cli agents clones get past authentication to a normal `! [rejected] (fetch first)`, so write access works.

Impact: this cost the epic its Apollo canary budget. Apollo's drain log rows at 11:27:13Z (bob-cli) and 11:30:04Z (sase) are the two canaries, both `git push failed: ... denied to deploy key`. Phase .6.3's first replay apply hit the same wall and fell back to an HTTPS credential helper. Clean local commits `a090a3a2c` (bob-cli--agents) and `f2d32a476b` (sase--agents) are still stranded ahead 1. No Apollo-local drain has run since. Any agent-driven Apollo sync, repair, or canary over SSH will keep failing the same way.

Fix direction (chezmoi-managed `~/.ssh` config): make `github.com` use `IdentitiesOnly yes` with the machine's own GitHub key on hosts that lack `id_sase_service` (Apollo: `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, which authenticates as bbugyi200), or stop forwarding the agent to tailnet hosts. Then verify that `ssh apollo 'zsh -lc "ssh -T git@github.com"'` greets bbugyi200. Related: sase-167 tracks the misclassification of `denied to deploy key` errors and the warning wording; it does not change SSH configuration.

task_type_fields.impact: Every agent-driven publication push on Apollo over SSH (sase agent sync canaries, the replay helper, manifest repair) fails with denied to deploy key, stranding local agents commits; this burned the sase-1nf.10.1.9.1.6 Apollo canary budget.
task_type_fields.location: chezmoi private_dot_ssh config: Athena Host * ForwardAgent yes plus a github.com IdentitiesOnly match gated on id_sase_service (absent on Apollo)
task_type_fields.repro: From athena: `ssh apollo 'zsh -lc "ssh -T git@github.com; git -C ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents push --dry-run origin HEAD:refs/heads/main"'` greets `bobs-org/bob` and fails with `denied to deploy key`. Repeat with `ssh -o ForwardAgent=no apollo ...`: it greets `bbugyi200` and reaches a normal non-fast-forward rejection.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1nf.10.1.9.1.6.4 canaries reported lost Apollo write access. The landing audit traced it to Athena's forwarded ssh-agent offering a deploy key that Apollo's github.com config does not exclude. That cost the epic's Apollo canary budget and still blocks agent-driven Apollo publication.
